notes: Expanded to full story set covering recovery, tests, and integration.

GOV-F-003-S119.title: Brain Lock Expiration and Recovery Logic
GOV-F-003-S119.description: Implement automatic expiration handling and recovery logic for stale locks. Detect expired locks via TTL and allow new ownership acquisition. Ensure safe takeover semantics (no double ownership) and audit logging of recovery events.

GOV-F-003-S120.title: Brain Lock Concurrency and Race Condition Safeguards
GOV-F-003-S120.description: Implement atomic locking guarantees using MongoDB operations (e.g., findOneAndUpdate with conditions) to prevent concurrent acquisition conflicts. Validate behavior under simultaneous requests and enforce single-owner invariant.

GOV-F-003-S121.title: Brain Lock Unit and Integration Tests
GOV-F-003-S121.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock lifecycle: acquire, renew, expire, recover, and concurrent access scenarios. Validate TTL expiration behavior and ownership enforcement across edge cases.

GOV-F-003-S122.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S122.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into brain_runner and brain_loop execution flow. Ensure each assignment execution acquires a lock, renews during long operations, and releases or recovers appropriately on failure.
